services.name: Power and energy
services.summary: UPS systems, VRLA and lithium-ion batteries, and renewable energy setups, with installation, configuration, preventive maintenance, battery replacement and annual service contracts in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
services.details: Online UPS conditions power continuously and carries the load through an outage. VRLA batteries are the lower-cost, long-standing choice but shorter-lived in hot rooms. Lithium-ion batteries have a smaller footprint, better heat tolerance and a longer life, at a higher purchase price. Smart infrastructure and sustainability covers measuring and managing power use, IT performance and environmental impact together.

process: Schedule a call at a time that suits you.

faq.a: Organisations that cannot afford downtime: government and the public sector, healthcare, banking and finance, energy and utilities, and industrial sites. What they share is critical IT that depends on reliable power, which is where one supplier for both helps most.

faq.q: Do you support small and large businesses?
faq.a: Yes. JIO works with SMEs, enterprises, government bodies and industrial clients, and scales each solution to the organisation.

faq.q: Do you install and maintain UPS systems in Dubai and Abu Dhabi?
faq.a: Yes: installation, configuration, preventive maintenance, battery replacement and annual service contracts.

faq.q: Can you design and build data centers?
faq.a: Yes, end to end: construction, hosting, cabling, power integration and cooling, for small to enterprise environments.

faq.q: Do you offer CCTV and physical security?
faq.a: Yes: camera and recorder installation, remote monitoring, and integration with the IT network.

faq.q: Can you supply IT hardware and power equipment?
faq.a: Yes: networking equipment, servers, storage, UPS units, power distribution units and energy-efficient hardware.
